Name: Better Chipper
Author: Larvuk
Description:
[size=5][b]Less bullshit more wood[/b][/size]

[size=3][b]A simple mod that enhances the efficiency of the vanilla Wood Chipper machine (sold at Robin's).[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]The problem[/b][/size]

[size=3]I never use the Wood Chipper because it needs hours to give you, like, 8 wood. When you need wood you need hundreds of pieces. So you leave your farm, go for a tree-rampage in the forest, come back 4 hours later with 500 pieces of wood, add the 8 useless pieces from the chipper to your stack, realize it's too late to go to Robin's, and tomorrow is aerobic club day.[/size]

[size=3]So you try not to cry while you open your chest to store your 508 pieces of wood and infinite sap with your 122 pieces of useless hardwood. Yes, I hate my life.[/size]

[size=4][b]The solution[/b][/size]

[size=3]Now you can load 1 to 20 pieces of hardwood and the processing time is reduced to 1 in-game hour. Loading 20 pieces will give you 200 to 230 pieces of regular wood.[/size]
[size=3]You won't get any resin, tar or syrup, just the loads of plain wood you deserved for so long.[/size]

[size=3]You also deserve a sincere "sorry" from your father, but I checked, there is no mod for it.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Better Chipper
Manifest.Description: Makes the Wood Chipper more useful by processing more wood and work quicker.
Manifest.Author: Larvük
